scope: B AI12 independent new-only acceptance; original246 assertions retained

rows.assertion: Open on current interface and show exact document version/provider/model/outbound payload
rows.detail: Exact server version/provider/model/outbound JSON displayed and compared.

rows.assertion: unconfigured provider and unchecked consent disable generation
rows.detail: Unchecked consent disables generation; configured=false UI fixture disabled. Actual absent-provider HTTP test passes.

rows.assertion: consent checkbox applies to displayed payload and is reset on close/reopen or document change
rows.detail: Close/reopen resets consent; changed document rejects old payload409; reopen shows new payload unchecked.

rows.assertion: loading/Close/Escape/repeated open cannot strand overlay or reuse previous-interface state
rows.detail: Delayed load ignores Escape while busy then settles; repeated reopen and interface Back clear all dialogs and state.

rows.assertion: Generate only after consent and show complete HTML/Markdown/field-annotation diff as safe text
rows.detail: Fixed local LLM HTML source/Markdown/query-description diffs shown as text; no rendered h2/script in preview.

rows.assertion: discard saves nothing and retry uses intended idempotency
rows.detail: First completed generation response lost; retry same requestId; discard leaves version unchanged; fresh generation uses new ID.

rows.assertion: accept once creates revision then refreshes interface and clears proposal/consent
rows.detail: Repeated accept one write, exactly one new revision, proposal removed, consent cleared, reload displays stored Markdown and field snapshot.

rows.assertion: concurrent legacy edit produces visible stale error without overwriting newer document
rows.detail: Concurrent legacy edit rejects accept409 and preserves current document.

rows.assertion: Load history and earlier pages without duplicate versions, retaining actor/time/kind
rows.detail: 54 real versions paginate with unique version IDs, kind/actor/time retained.

rows.assertion: inspect current/original/old field snapshots and label incomplete history
rows.detail: Current/intermediate/baseline snapshots opened and compared with API. Incomplete-history HTTP UI fixture shows explicit legacy label; script-like text remains text.

rows.assertion: Cancel restore writes nothing, confirm creates a new revision preserving history
rows.detail: Cancel restore unchanged revision; repeated confirmation one new restore revision, prior lineage preserved.

rows.assertion: repeated restore, navigation and stale version failure never rewrite another interface
rows.detail: Stale confirmation409 zero overwrite; refreshed explicit re-confirm succeeds; lost-response retry409 creates no duplicate; navigation closes confirmation.

contract: POST /api/documentation/restore now requires numeric safe nonnegative expectedVersion captured when confirmation opens. Missing/malformed=400; stale=409 before history preparation. Existing BSON CAS protects races after read. No automatic retry/rebase. Readonly MCP unchanged.
fixes: Stale restore overwrote newer legacy documentation.
Restore confirmation could sit underneath reopened assistant modal; explicit local1000/1100 stacking fixes real pointer blockage.

validation.database: Each UI test validates only its synthetic interface ID and project with fixture marker, version/Markdown against Mongo readback.
validation.visual: 1920x1080 actual review: current history, incomplete label and safe text visible; long history scrolls in modal.

limitations: Old version has no AI assistant; new-only acceptance is not old/new parity or an N/A pass.
configured=false and incomplete legacy-history display use explicitly recorded HTTP UI fixtures; actual HTTP absent-provider and store lineage unit tests complement them.
Initial combined-overlay unit run used old C environment fixture against C new component and had one unrelated failure; exact B-only product run315pass supersedes it.
Read-only MCP is covered by existing unit tests; no end-user MCP session is claimed.
